mechanics.title: Visual only
mechanics.description: Shows both the worn chestplate and the elytra on the player model.

getting_started: Combine a chestplate and elytra using an armored elytra datapack (if the pack includes one), then wear it.
editor_notes: Jar missing from facts (missingJar). Modrinth page says it needs a separate datapack (Vanilla Tweaks Armored Elytra or Voodoo Beard's Plated Elytra) and lists support only up to 1.20.4; the pack uses CurseForge project 1056156 for 26.2, which may be a newer file. Verify whether the pack includes a datapack that makes the combined item; a grep of datapack facts found no armored elytra pack by name (only track-statistics and dragon_drops mention elytra).
name: Armored Elytra
summary: Client-side mod that renders a chestplate and elytra on the player at the same time. It adds no crafting recipe of its own; combining the two items is done by a separate datapack.
